name: ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 (N4X)
description: Official $8 ESP32-C3 board: C3-MINI-1 module (4 MB flash), RGB LED, BOOT/RST buttons and 2x15 breadboard pins; the cheap RISC-V Wi-Fi + BLE 5 starting point with a KiCad footprint.
notes: Addressable RGB LED on GPIO8. GPIO8 and GPIO9 (the BOOT button) are strapping pins; GPIO2 is also a strapping pin.
USB goes through a CP2102N bridge; the native USB Serial/JTAG pins (GPIO18/19) are on the headers but not on the connector.
The original 4 MB ESP32-C3-DevKitM-1 is obsolete; the N4X (in-package-flash MINI-1) is the current part. -1U has an external antenna connector.
Length includes ~5.5 mm antenna overhang (PCB 38.91 mm, estimated from the drawing).
